tips.text: Hit your daily cap with normal play first, then turn in Syndicate Alert Medallions, which also let you control how much you gain.
Burn the daily cap fast with Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, leaving after round 8 and repeating, or the Duviri Circuit.
Keep playing while Perrin waits at its Rank 1 cap; New Loka still earns half of what you would have gained.
Treat it as Mastery fodder; nobody complains about the farm, and earlier Syndicate grinding often gives you ranks for free.
